propositions: pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 + anthropic 0.120.2 fails to import AnthropicModel because pydantic_ai.models.anthropic expects UserLocation from anthropic.types.beta.beta_web_search_tool_20250305_param, which does not exist in anthropic 0.120.2

uv's universal resolution cannot co-satisfy [eval]'s boto3>=1.40.46,<1.40.62 (via inspect-ai → aiobotocore) and [bedrock]/[dev]'s boto3>=1.42.63 (via pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]>=1.107), forcing downgrade to pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0
pip is unaffected because it installs one extra set at a time, never co-resolving [dev]/[agents] with [eval]'s boto3 caps, thus provisioning the healthy 1.107.1 + 0.120.2 pair

declaring [tool.uv] conflicts = [[{extra="eval"},{extra="bedrock"}], [{extra="eval"},{extra="dev"}]] plus raising pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries] floor to >=1.107,<2 resolves the conflict and restores pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2
a CI smoke test asserting 'from pydantic_ai.models.anthropic import AnthropicModel' succeeds in the locked dev environment guards against regression
